name: AsterixDB
tagline: Apache parallel database for semi-structured JSON data with SQL++, LSM storage and spatial/text indexes.
description: Apache AsterixDB is a shared-nothing parallel database for semi-structured data that began as an NSF-funded UC Irvine and UC Riverside project in 2009, was first released in 2013 and became an Apache top-level project in April 2016. It stores JSON-like ADM records in partitioned LSM trees with B+tree, R-tree and inverted keyword indexes, runs queries in SQL++ (SQL extended for nested data) on the Hyracks dataflow engine, and can also query external data in HDFS or object stores and ingest continuously via data feeds. Transactions are record-level, NoSQL-style. Couchbase's Analytics service is built on it, and commits remain frequent, but formal Apache releases are slow: 0.9.9 (March 2024) is the current stable version.
developer: Apache Software Foundation (originally UC Irvine and UC Riverside)

scale.notes: Hash-partitions datasets across nodes and executes queries in parallel on Hyracks; designed for clusters of commodity machines.

strengths: SQL++ handles nested and heterogeneous JSON with full join and aggregation power
Partitioned LSM storage sustains high ingest while keeping secondary indexes current
R-tree spatial, inverted keyword and B+tree indexes in one engine
Queries both managed datasets and external data in HDFS or object storage
Apache-licensed, with production lineage through Couchbase Analytics
weaknesses: Infrequent formal releases (0.9.9 in 2024) despite active commits
Small community outside academia and Couchbase
Only record-level transactions; no multi-statement ACID
Few managed offerings and limited ecosystem tooling
useCases: Analytics over large semi-structured JSON datasets
Spatial and text queries over social media or sensor feeds
Database systems research and teaching (SQL++, LSM, parallel execution)
Querying data lakes on HDFS or object storage alongside managed data
notIdealFor: Teams wanting a commercially supported, frequently released product
